slot.brief: Two statements with all/some quantifiers; ask which conclusions definitely follow.

stem:
**Statements:**
All poets are readers.
Some readers are dancers.

**Conclusions:**
I. Some dancers are readers.
II. Some poets are dancers.

verdicts.working: Some readers are dancers, so some dancers are readers (I). No premise establishes that any poets are dancers (II).

working:
The readers who are dancers are also dancers who are readers; hence I follows. They need not be poets, so II does not definitely follow.

Independent check: Some readers are dancers, so some dancers are readers (I). No premise establishes that any poets are dancers (II).
solution: Some readers are dancers; hence, some dancers are readers, so conclusion I follows. The statements do not establish that any poets are dancers, so conclusion II does not follow.
